results.body_snippet: ## Problem `IssueActions` renders the fund button whenever `bounty.status === "open"`, for any visitor (signed out or not). The backend's `BountiesService.fund` throws 403 *"Only the bounty sponsor can fund this bounty"* for anyone whose id isn't `sponsorId`. Contributors browsing open bounties are invited to connect a wallet and then get an error. Refund already uses an `isSponsor` gate. ## Suggested fix Gate fund on `isSponsor` as well, and show a neutral "Awaiting sponsor funding" state other

results.title: An expired bounty's sponsor has no refund button, though EXPIRED → REFUNDED is the only way to get the escrow back
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem The refund button only renders for `funded`/`claimed`. Expired bounties fall into the disabled "No action available" group. The backend's state machine allows `EXPIRED → REFUNDED` precisely so a sponsor can reclaim funds after the deadline sweep, and the sweep does **not** refund automatically. Sponsors of expired bounties can't recover their escrow from the UI. ## Suggested fix Show "Refund sponsor" for `expired` when `isSponsor`, with copy explaining the deadline passed. Related: #2

results.title: Bounty board says every bounty is 'backed by funds already locked in escrow' while listing unfunded OPEN bounties
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `/issues` intro copy: *"Every bounty below is backed by funds already locked in a Soroban escrow contract."* The page lists every status, including `open`, which in the backend's state machine means **not yet funded** (`OPEN → FUNDED` happens on the sponsor's fund call). Contributors are told an unfunded bounty is guaranteed. ## Suggested fix Make the claim conditional ("Funded bounties are backed by…"), and show an explicit "Not yet funded" badge on OPEN cards. Related: #49, #259

A transient backend blip serves real bounty URLs as **404 Not Found**: search engines may drop them, and users see "doesn't exist" instead of "try again". ## Suggested fix Distinguish "backend said 404" from "backend unavailable". Throw on the latter so the route's `error.tsx` renders a retryable error (and return

results.title: Bounty status polling never stops for terminal states (paid, refunded, expired)
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `useBountyStatus` keeps `useSmartPolling` enabled regardless of status. Once a bounty is `paid`, `refunded` or `expired`, it can never change again, yet the page keeps polling (backing off to 30 s) for as long as the tab stays open. ## Suggested fix Pass `enabled: !TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(status)` so polling stops once a terminal status is observed. Related: #46, #570

results.title: Each issue page runs two independent pollers on the same bounty (ClaimButton every 2s, LiveBountyStatus every 5s)

Each poller calls `fetchBounty` (full bounty, `cache: "no-store"`). A single open tab makes about 42 backend requests a minute for one bounty. results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem Team payouts are a headline feature (the issue detail page renders `teamSplits` and validates them, #85), but `POST /teams`, `PATCH /teams/:id/splits` and `POST /teams/:id/assign/:bountyId` have no frontend. results.title: The maintainer pipeline shows every bounty on the platform, not the maintainer's own repositories
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `MaintainerDashboardPage` renders `fetchBounties(mockBounties)`, the full public board, as the maintainer's "pipeline", along with the stats derived from it. A maintainer of one repository sees every other project's bounties in their Kanban columns and counts. ## Suggested fix Filter by the maintainer's repositories (backend: `repositoryId` filter plus a "my repositories" endpoint), and show an empty state with "Connect repository" when there are none. Related: #88, #226

results.title: Deadline countdown says 'deadline passed' for a bounty that is due later today
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `daysUntil` compares UTC calendar days, so a deadline later today gives `0`, and `formatDaysUntil` only treats `days > 0` as remaining. Everything else renders `deadline.passed`. A bounty due at 23:00 UTC shows as already expired from 00:00 UTC, which discourages claims on bounties that are still open. Negative and zero are conflated. ## Suggested fix Distinguish `0` ("Due today") from `< 0` (passed), or compute from the exact timestamp (hours remaining when under 1 day). Related: #10

results.title: components/bounty/LiveBountyStatus.tsx has no test file
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `src/components/bounty/LiveBountyStatus.tsx` wires the issue page's live status polling (interval 5000) to BountyStatus. No `*.test.ts(x)` sits beside it and no other test imports it (checked with `find src -name '*.test.*'`). ## Suggested fix Add a test covering that it renders the fallback status immediately and passes its interval through. Related: #46

results.title: word_count() miscounts extra whitespace
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `word_count("hello world")` (two spaces) returns `3`, and `word_count("")` returns `1`. Words separated by any amount of whitespace, including tabs and newlines, should count once: `word_count("one\ttwo\nthree")` should be `3`. Empty or whitespace-only text has 0 words.
